issues.finding: The pair macro requires two mandatory arguments but the displayed contraction supplies only one comma-separated argument.
issues.proposed_resolution: Give N1 and N2 as separate pair macro arguments.

issues.finding: The injection macro has one optional type annotation followed by two mandatory arguments; this call instead supplies three mandatory arguments and changes their roles.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use the optional annotation form inj[A]{i}{N}.

issues.finding: The typing rules annotate injection with the complementary sum type. The displayed injection into A1-or-A2 instead repeats Ai, the payload's own type.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use A_(3-i), for i equal to 1 or 2, as the complementary injection annotation.

issues.finding: The generic substitution explanation is itself ordered correctly, but reverses the M/Ni roles of the preceding contraction and omits the bound-variable renaming needed for capture avoidance. This is not evidence of a reversed substitution operator.
issues.proposed_resolution: Explain the displayed Subst{Ni}{M}{xi} directly and require renaming binders when necessary to avoid capture.

issues.finding: The sequence repeats the same M2 as consecutive one-step reducts, introducing an unintended reflexive step.
issues.proposed_resolution: Remove the duplicated M2 one-step occurrence while preserving the explicit zero-step case k=1.

translation_treatment: Complete direct translation of product, sum and function contractions, permutation example, contextual closure and normality. Correct macro arity, injection syntax/annotation and the reduction chain; clarify capture-avoiding substitution without falsely treating the generic source definition as reversed.
